headline: Approved 44 South Main Street theater addition, 80 Storrs Street shopping center changes, and a mail center at 7 Rectory Road.
summary: Several items were continued to later dates at the applicants' request, including three Loudon Road projects. Sign designs for seven agenda items were approved as a group. A 59-unit planned development off Sonoma Lane received preliminary design review.
decisions: Approved architectural design review for sign items 5A through 5G, 9-0-0, with conditions on items 5A and 5B.
Continued agenda item 6A, a 110-unit multifamily building at 270 Loudon Road, to December 16, 2026, at the applicant's request.
Continued agenda item 6B, retail and bank buildings at 282 Loudon Road, to December 16, 2026.
Continued agenda item 6C, a four-lot subdivision at 270 Loudon Road, to December 16, 2026.
Continued agenda item 7A, a two-unit condominium conversion at 3 Palm Street, to March 17, 2026.
Continued agenda item 7B, a micro-data center at 52 Locke Road, to December 16, 2026.
Granted a conditional use permit for a pet grooming salon at 85 Manchester Street Unit 1B, 9-0-0.
Approved a minor subdivision for a lot line adjustment between 110 and 114 Peaceful Lane, 8-0-0, with conditions.
Recommended that the City Council allow building permits on the private roadway at Peaceful Lane, 8-0-0.
Granted a conditional use permit for wetland buffer impact at 7 Rectory Road, 8-0-0.
Granted a conditional use permit to build fewer parking spaces than normally required at 7 Rectory Road, 8-0-0.
Approved major site plan for a mail center building at 7 Rectory Road, 8-0-0, with conditions.
Approved a minor subdivision for a lot line adjustment between 56 and 60 Bow Street, 9-0-0, with conditions.
Continued agenda item 7G, a 9-space parking lot on Carter Hill Road, to March 17, 2026.
Approved minor site plan for a 4,200-square-foot addition to the theater at 44 South Main Street, 9-0-0, with conditions.
Approved an amendment allowing 5 new parking lot light poles at 52-54 Portsmouth Street, 9-0-0.
Granted a conditional use permit to build fewer parking spaces at 80 Storrs Street: 769 where 1,247 are required, 9-0-0.
Approved minor site plan for converting space at 80 Storrs Street into restaurant and retail units, 9-0-0, with conditions.
Continued agenda item 7K, decorative building lighting at 80 Storrs Street, to December 16, 2026.
Completed the design review phase for a 59-unit planned development off Sonoma Lane, 9-0-0, and ended the public meeting.
